gate_definitions.offhigh: Close at least 50% below trailing 504-bar high
gate_definitions.rsi: Existing browser Wilder RSI(14) <=45; scorer truncates input to latest 560 bars
gate_definitions.bb: Existing browser 20-bar Bollinger bandwidth <=20th percentile of approximately 252 bars
gate_definitions.spread: Median last 10 bar ranges/close <=75% of earlier 40 bars within last 60
gate_definitions.exhaust: Existing browser capitulation at i-90..i-3: return <=-3%, volume >=1.7x preceding 20-bar median, close location >=0.25

sampling: Every eligible daily close after full in-window warm-up; do not deduplicate events before displaying the gate funnel
universe: Convenience sample of publicly accessible existing warehouse objects, not a historical investable universe
conflicting_duplicate_policy: Exclude entire affected asset; exact duplicates may be counted then collapsed
calendar_policy: Require consecutive calendar dates for BTC/ETH; equity session calendar unverified
returns: Retrospective close-to-close gross price changes; not executable fills, total returns, strategy NAV or OOS validation
omitted: all remaining browser/backend gates outside this technical subset
uncertainty: Report overlap-connected event clusters; no confidence interval or significance claim from this convenience sample
costs: No commissions, spread, slippage, impact, borrow, funding or dividend model; gross observations only
training: No fitting; PR19 validator must exclude labels lacking historical availability, without inventing clocks
